You are performing a bounded, read-only independent evidence audit for a historical project-state replay. Work only inside /run/fs-f/world and /run/fs-f/inbox. Do not write or modify any files, do not commit, and do not approve anything.

Read /run/fs-f/world/HANDOFF.md, /run/fs-f/world/PROJECT.md, and all files under /run/fs-f/world/sources/. The observation/planning time is 2026-03-02 09:00 UTC (ignore the machine's current date).

Your bounded sub-question: assess, strictly from the source text, whether the Echo and Reference models have adequate observed evidence for the site humidity ranges, and whether any manufacturer claim is being double-counted as independent evidence. In particular:
- List the exact RH and temperature ranges at S1, S2, S3.
- List the exact lab-sample coverage by model and the maximum absolute error observed.
- Compare those observed ranges with each model's claimed RH range and with each site's range.
- Determine which model/site combinations are supported by observed data, which are extrapolations, and which are unsupported.
- Check whether the procurement summary adds independent evidence or merely repeats the Echo brochure.
- Note the sample-size limitation and what it does and does not establish about a +/-3 ug/m3 working target.
- Identify the minimum targeted verification that would close any material gap, without assuming it is already done or funded.

Report: (1) a model/site evidence matrix, (2) your reasoning, (3) any caveats. Clearly label this as an independent check, not an accepted fact or approval. Keep it concise.
Your parent agent id is "session-9c6ce702-1e29-46d3-97e6-bae1767ac165". Before you finish, send your result to that agent with send_message({ agent_id: "session-9c6ce702-1e29-46d3-97e6-bae1767ac165", message: "<self-contained result>" }). The parent shares your workspace but does not automatically receive your transcript, tool output, or reasoning. Send earlier messages as well when a finding changes what the parent should do next; sending a message does not end your turn.
